name: 1P_PERMITTED_IN_THIS_BAY_AT_ALL_TIMES_GREEN_TALL
legend: 1P PERMITTED IN THIS BAY AT ALL TIMES (double arrow)
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA164 225 x 300 (2015, 1:5), R25, green on white, no border. 1P '100 D/E', 15 from the top, 135 overall centred (measured: 1 at x 45, 30 wide; P at x 99, 80 wide — both match Series E). Four lines 20 D, baselines 152 (37 below) / 184 / 216 / 248 (32 pitch): PERMITTED 134 (45/134/46), IN 22 + 15 + THIS 54 + 15 + BAY 51 (34 margins), AT 31 + 15 + ALL 48 (65 / 66 margins), TIMES 72 (76/72/77). Arrow centre line 26 below the last baseline (y 274), 26 from the bottom. The time limit (1P) is the sheet's example ('Parking (time period) permitted…'); not varied. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick).
